sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Game has reset to page 1
# Click 8 green blocks to get to page 2, then immediately click green blocks on page 2
seg = current_frame.segmentation
N_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"Light green blocks: {len(N_nodes)}")

# Get positions of first 8 blocks
click_positions = []
for n in N_nodes[:8]:
    rows = [p[0] for p in n['boundary']]
    cols = [p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
    center_row = (min(rows) + max(rows)) // 2
    center_col = (min(cols) + max(cols)) // 2
    click_positions.append((center_row, center_col))

# Click 8 green blocks to get to page 2
clicks = [{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': r, 'col': c} for r, c in click_positions]
action(clicks)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
